title: Getting started
body:
Press F1 for the in-game help topics.

Use /petition to reach a GM, or /bug to report a problem. Both open the Customer Services pages of the Help window, and both are answered by a person rather than by this article.

title: Reporting a bug
body:
Type /bug, or open Help and choose Report Bug.

Say what you were doing, what you expected, and what happened instead. Include where you were standing: the report carries your map and position automatically, but the name of the place helps.

One report per problem, please - a report covering three things is three times as hard to act on.

title: Petitions and what happens to them
body:
Type /petition, or open Help and choose Petition.

A petition is filed against your account and character, with the map and position you were at when you sent it. A GM reads it and either answers you in game or resolves it with a note.

There is a short cooldown between petitions. If you need to add something to one you have already sent, send a second petition referring to the first.
